name: peekhassio
description: Peek at Home Assistant entity states from the GNOME top bar.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:node && npm run test:gjs
scripts.test:node: node --test tests/entities/view-model.test.mjs tests/groups/panel-presentation.test.mjs tests/groups/view-model.test.mjs tests/instances/credential-store.test.mjs tests/instances/home-assistant-client.test.mjs tests/instances/view-model.test.mjs tests/runtime/coordinator.test.mjs tests/runtime/extension-runtime.test.mjs tests/shared/package.test.mjs tests/shared/preferences-api.test.mjs tests/shared/secret-detection.test.mjs tests/shared/signal-owner.test.mjs
scripts.coverage: npm run build && npm run coverage:node && npm run coverage:gjs
scripts.coverage:node: node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-lines=81 --test-coverage-branches=81 --test-coverage-functions=81 tests/entities/view-model.test.mjs tests/groups/panel-presentation.test.mjs tests/groups/view-model.test.mjs tests/instances/credential-store.test.mjs tests/instances/home-assistant-client.test.mjs tests/instances/view-model.test.mjs tests/runtime/coordinator.test.mjs tests/runtime/extension-runtime.test.mjs tests/shared/package.test.mjs tests/shared/preferences-api.test.mjs tests/shared/secret-detection.test.mjs tests/shared/signal-owner.test.mjs
scripts.coverage:gjs: gjs -C file://$PWD/dist/entities/configuration.js -C file://$PWD/dist/groups/configuration.js -C file://$PWD/dist/instances/configuration.js -C file://$PWD/dist/shared/action-runner.js -C file://$PWD/dist/shared/configuration.js --coverage-output=coverage/gjs -m tests/shared/configuration.test.mjs && gjs -C file://$PWD/dist/instances/soup-websocket-transport.js --coverage-output=coverage/gjs -m tests/instances/soup-websocket-transport.test.mjs && node scripts/ci/check-gjs-coverage.mjs
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && node scripts/build/copy-metadata.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build && gnome-extensions pack --force --out-dir . --extra-source=entities --extra-source=groups --extra-source=gtk --extra-source=instances --extra-source=runtime --extra-source=shared --schema=schemas/org.gnome.shell.extensions.peekhassio.gschema.xml dist && node scripts/ci/check-extension-package.mjs peekhassio@de-gouveia.eu.shell-extension.zip
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run coverage
